name: fanbasis
one_liner: FanBasis is a platform that lets creators sell digital products and services with built‑in checkout, subscriptions, and webhooks.
auth_notes: No OAuth, no client ID/secret pairs — Fanbasis uses a single API key with separate test/live environments.
access_notes: Keys created with the default settings carry all scopes, so most integrations never see a 403.

evidence.snippet: Create and copy keys in your dashboard under Account → API Keys (CLI: `commas keys add sandbox`).

Seven new endpoints under `/public-api/invoices`: creating an invoice also emails it to the recipient with a hosted payment page, plus list/get, next sequential number, resend (payment reminder), void, and mark-paid.
